# Firebase Basics — CLI Setup

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the foundational Firebase CLI setup skill: installation and version checks (`npx -y firebase-tools@latest`), login (including `--no-localhost` for browserless environments), project creation and selection, programmatic `google-services.json` / `GoogleService-Info.plist` downloads via the CLI (never the console), agent-environment setup guides (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Android Studio, Antigravity), the Firebase MCP server preference, usage principles, and common-issue handling. Pairs with the sibling basics skills: firebase-hosting-basics (classic Hosting deploys), firebase-remote-config-basics (Remote Config templates), and xcode-project-setup (iOS SPM linking). Distinct from the published firebase-ai-logic-basics (lot 30, which covers Firebase AI Logic, not CLI setup). Requires a Google account with Firebase enabled; Firebase CLI and project use are billed on Google's paid tiers beyond the free allowance — a paid service for real projects. By @firebase, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
